args.title: Corvid Packaging freight pricing summary
args.body:
- Corvid Packaging's latest newsletter highlights its "Freight pricing this quarter" article, pointing readers to the blog post and a companion piece tailored to the reader's company.
- The article reports that spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, and that fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- The companion piece finds that shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
